title: Kneaded Springy Venezuelan Dough Empanadas
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring a fatty and springy dough filled with raisins, perfect for a Mediterranean-friendly snack. This recipe uses a long-fermentation dough to create a nostalgic and delicious treat.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar, then stir to combine.
Add melted butter, eggs, and water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a few raisins in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
